Question 1
?

Find L{f(t)} for the piecewise function defined by

f(t)={0,t<1−7,1≤t≤30,t>3.

a
L{f(t)}=e−3s−e−s
b
L{f(t)}=7s(e−3s−e−s)
c
L{f(t)}=e−7s−1
d
L{f(t)}=17(e3s−es)
e
L{f(t)}=1s(1−e7s)
Submit
